qa_summary.limitations: No importer, live audio, browser, independent academic or writing/oral grading QA

units.title: A changed meeting plan — listening preparation
units.prerequisites: P01-U06 or equivalent real-audio Listening introduction
units.goal: Identify the main purpose and changed time/place of a spoken school message, but earn no Listening credit without verified original MP3.
units.concept: Before listening, predict whether the message is about a place, time or instruction. First listen for the main idea, then listen for the changed detail. A transcript is preparation material, not proof of hearing.
units.support_vi: Học cách làm qua ví dụ riêng, sau đó tự trả lời bài tập. Chỉ bài có đáp án khách quan mới có thể được chấm sau khi duyệt; bài viết/nói tự do không được tự chấm điểm.
units.model: Independent written model (not assessed): 'The art room is closed. Meet outside the library at four.' First identify the change (place), then verify the new place (outside the library).
strategy: Read the situation without seeing the target transcript.
When approved audio exists, listen once for purpose and again for details.
Compare the audio cue to each option; if audio is unavailable, do not answer for Listening credit.
units.hint: Listen for change markers such as instead, now and moved to.
units.feedback_strategy: After approved audio playback and Submit, explain the time/place cue, show transcript and replay. Without MP3, use the script only as reading preparation, with no Listening score.
units.draft_audio_script: Hello, science club members. Our usual classroom is being repaired today. Instead, please meet in the school courtyard at three fifteen this afternoon. Bring your notebook. See you there!

practice.prompt: What is the new meeting place mentioned in the script?

feedback.explanation_en: The message moves the group to the school courtyard.

practice.prompt: When should the group meet according to the script?

feedback.explanation_en: The speaker gives the revised time as 3:15 p.m.

practice.prompt: Why is the plan changing?

feedback.explanation_en: The old room is being repaired, so the location changes.

practice.prompt: Write one useful phrase that signals a change in a spoken announcement.

feedback.self_check_en: Possible cues include instead, moved to, or now. This is vocabulary reflection, not a listening score.

units.title: Polite requests with can and could
units.prerequisites: P01-U02 and existing Grammar foundation (exact reusable lesson ID requires confirmation)
units.goal: Choose can or could in clear school requests and distinguish requests from statements.
units.concept: Use Can I ...? and Could I ...? to request permission politely. Could is often more tentative; neither guarantees permission. For a request, keep the base verb after the modal: Could I borrow ...? not Could I borrowing ...?
units.support_vi: Học cách làm qua ví dụ riêng, sau đó tự trả lời bài tập. Chỉ bài có đáp án khách quan mới có thể được chấm sau khi duyệt; bài viết/nói tự do không được tự chấm điểm.
units.model: Different model: 'Could I open the window, please?' The speaker asks permission; open is the base verb. 'I open the window' is a statement, not a permission request.
strategy: Identify whether the speaker is asking permission.
Choose can/could plus the base verb.
Check whether the request is polite and grammatically complete.
units.hint: After can/could, look for the base form of the verb.
units.feedback_strategy: After Submit, contrast a grammatical permission question with a statement or an incorrect -ing form.
units.reuse_note: Link to an existing Grammar lesson only after verifying its actual ID and prerequisite match; do not duplicate or overwrite legacy curriculum.

practice.prompt: Choose the best polite request to use the school printer.

options.text: Could I use the printer, please?

feedback.explanation_en: Could I use ...? correctly uses the base verb and asks permission.

practice.prompt: Complete the question: '___ I sit here, please?'

feedback.explanation_en: Can I ...? is a common polite permission question.

practice.prompt: Which sentence is a statement rather than a request?

feedback.explanation_en: I need a pen describes a need; it does not directly ask permission.

practice.prompt: Which verb form follows 'Could I' in a correct request?

feedback.explanation_en: A modal verb is followed by the base verb: Could I borrow ...?

practice.prompt: Write your own polite request to use a classroom object.

feedback.self_check_en: Check for Can/Could I + base verb + object + please. This original sentence is unassessed until reviewed.

units.title: Prepare and practise: explaining a missed deadline
units.goal: Plan a respectful explanation and request for help, then practise aloud without receiving a speaking proficiency score.
units.concept: A clear request has a greeting, a factual problem, one relevant reason, a specific next-step question and thanks. Do not promise an extension; ask what is possible.
units.support_vi: Học cách làm qua ví dụ riêng, sau đó tự trả lời bài tập. Chỉ bài có đáp án khách quan mới có thể được chấm sau khi duyệt; bài viết/nói tự do không được tự chấm điểm.
units.model: Independent model: 'Excuse me, I could not attend the club meeting because I was ill. Could you tell me what I missed? Thank you.' Notice the factual reason and specific question.
strategy: Write three keywords for the problem, reason and request.
Speak aloud using keywords instead of reading a complete script.
Self-check clarity and politeness; no oral performance is measured.
units.hint: A respectful request explains the situation without blaming someone else.
units.feedback_strategy: Self-check whether the request names the problem and asks a clear question. No microphone, speech evaluation, fluency mark or CEFR result is implied.

practice.prompt: Which message asks for a next step respectfully?

options.text: Could you tell me how to submit the late work?

feedback.explanation_en: A specific polite question asks for guidance without demanding an outcome.

practice.prompt: Which detail is most useful when explaining a missed deadline?

feedback.explanation_en: A concise relevant reason helps the listener understand the situation.

practice.prompt: Plan three keywords: problem, reason, request. Do not write a full script.

feedback.self_check_en: Check that the request is specific and respectful. Planning is not oral proficiency evidence.

practice.prompt: Practise aloud for about 20–40 seconds, then note one phrase you would improve.

feedback.self_check_en: This is self-reported practice only; no recording or observed speaking score.

units.title: Read a school project update and write a useful reply
units.goal: Identify two changed project requirements and draft a clear reply that acknowledges them and asks one useful question.
units.concept: For an update, separate what stays the same from what changes. In a reply, confirm the new requirement, say what you will do, and ask only for missing information.
units.support_vi: Học cách làm qua ví dụ riêng, sau đó tự trả lời bài tập. Chỉ bài có đáp án khách quan mới có thể được chấm sau khi duyệt; bài viết/nói tự do không được tự chấm điểm.
units.model: Different model: A club moves its rehearsal from Monday to Thursday. A useful reply is: 'Thanks for the update. I can come on Thursday. Should I bring the same music folder?' This confirms the change and asks one relevant question.
strategy: Read the complete update, noting the original and revised instructions.
Answer independent comprehension questions from the update.
Plan a reply: acknowledge, confirm action, ask one specific question.
units.hint: Check the newest message; older details may have been replaced.
units.feedback_strategy: After Submit, show the precise updated instruction for objective reading answers. Give a revision checklist for the unassessed original reply.
units.assessed_text: Monday notice: The environment project teams will meet on Friday at 3:30 p.m. in Room 8. Bring a photograph of your local area. Submit your final project on Friday. Wednesday update: Our planning meeting has moved to Thursday at 3:30 p.m. in Room 8. Please bring a draft poster instead of a photograph. The final submission deadline is still Friday.

writing_task_model.task: Write a polite reply to the teacher

practice.prompt: When is the revised project meeting?

feedback.explanation_en: The newer message changes the meeting to Thursday at 3:30 p.m.

practice.prompt: Which item must each group bring now?

feedback.explanation_en: The revised instructions specifically request a draft poster.

practice.prompt: Which statement is supported by the latest message?

feedback.explanation_en: The latest message says the Friday submission deadline remains unchanged.

practice.prompt: Write a 35–55-word reply to the teacher. Acknowledge the new meeting time and item, then ask one useful question.

feedback.self_check_en: Check Topic (project update), Task (reply), Must Include (new meeting, draft poster, question), Boundary (teacher, polite tone, 35–55 words). Do not self-award writing proficiency.

units.title: School communication: independent retrieval and repair
units.prerequisites: P01-U01 through P01-U14 as available; do not imply all were completed
units.goal: Retrieve useful school language across vocabulary, requests, updates and written communication, and identify a specific next topic to review.
units.concept: Retrieval means answering without rereading a model first. Review your answer only after submission, identify the kind of error and revisit the relevant concept. Recognition checks do not prove fluent speaking or original writing.
units.support_vi: Học cách làm qua ví dụ riêng, sau đó tự trả lời bài tập. Chỉ bài có đáp án khách quan mới có thể được chấm sau khi duyệt; bài viết/nói tự do không được tự chấm điểm.
units.model: Different model: A learner mistakes 'hand in a form' for 'check a timetable'. The repair is to identify the action: hand in means submit a completed document. The learner then writes a fresh example in a different situation.
strategy: Hide earlier lesson notes and answer independently.
Check explanations and classify mistakes: meaning, form, changed detail or register.
Choose one targeted earlier unit to revisit; do not convert practice completion into a CEFR certification.
units.hint: Which action or new instruction matters in this situation?
units.feedback_strategy: After Submit, give a short reason and name the prerequisite unit to revisit for each error. Repeat a different-context practice later; the review interval is advisory.
units.retrieval_intervals_advisory: Optional review after 2 and 7 days; no automatic scheduling or memory guarantee.

practice.prompt: You finished a permission slip. What should you do with it?

options.text: Hand it in to the office

feedback.explanation_en: Hand in means submit a completed document. Review P01-U01/U10 language chunks if unsure.

practice.prompt: Which request is polite and grammatical?

options.text: Could I borrow a notebook, please?

feedback.explanation_en: Could I + base verb makes a polite request. Review P01-U11 if unsure.

practice.prompt: A new message says 'Meet in Room 6 instead of Room 2.' Which room is current?

feedback.explanation_en: Instead of marks the replacement; follow the latest message. Review P01-U08 if unsure.

practice.prompt: What should a short reply to a changed deadline do?

options.text: Confirm the new deadline and ask a relevant question if needed

feedback.explanation_en: An effective reply acknowledges the update and clarifies missing information. Review P01-U14 if unsure.

practice.prompt: Write one original sentence requesting help with a new school problem.

feedback.self_check_en: Self-check Can/Could + base verb + specific help request. This production task is unassessed.
